entry.title: New: Resolution 417 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE FRIENDS OF THE PALACE THEATER FOR THE 6TH ANNUAL “TIS THE SEASON – A WALK THROUGH CHRISTMAS TOWN” EVENT

Transfers $1,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 1)
